name: s006_shroud
description: Shroud bias relative to the ioniser: -2.5 to +1 kV x target position -4, -2, 0 mm x caesium supply 1 and 3 mA, at 20/8/2.5 kV. A positive shroud suppresses emission from the outer zone of the shell (the halo), tightening the spot and the Si- emittance at the cost of current.
